svg.text: Self-tuner MM optimum by hourly run (rebuilt)
Dot = value the tuner's fit window picks at each hourly run (larger = more often the optimum in a block bootstrap); orange = live value; green dashed = literature.
Run time, UTC, 22 Oct 2026. Window = first log (21 Oct 22:43) to the run time; fit = older 70 %, test = newest 30 %. Source: research_notes/mm_upgrade_study.py
